mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, r.average_rating, s.sub_category_id, s.website_url, s.gmap_url, s.address, s.business_hours, s.closed_days, s.estimated_budget, s.keywords, s.details, s.deleted_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM spots s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = s.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) sp ON true JOIN ( SELECT spot_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY spot_id ) r ON r.spot_id = s.id ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
